scope: Parameter scenarios for full decode, not a calibrated chip prediction or GPU comparison

stochastic_fixed_core.mapping: 64 single-output cores per 64x64 tile; remove measured weight-register block; shared frontend is architectural assumption

stochastic_dual_core.description: Uses fixed-weight core cost as replaceable placeholder; no dual-stream synthesized power supplied

weight_macro.description: Area includes the selected cache implementation and its overhead; active tile prepare/hold area and energy are separate explicit macro parameters

external_memory_and_scratchpad.description: Example coefficients only. No SRAM/DRAM compiler output, real memory part or PHY power supplied

digital_MAC.description: Inherited FP16 multiply plus FP32 add proxy from prior project ledger; not measured BF16 fused MAC or 55nm cost

rng.description: Uniform raw word source, not configurable-probability p-bit
rng.weight_decision_raw_bits: 8*256/254 for byte rejection then uniform 0..126 to preserve |code|/127; ideal packing, rejection logic costs not calibrated
rng.input_sharing: one input-feature stream reused across output tiles via raw-word replay
rng.weight_sharing: independent per connection; any shared-weight sequence changes the quality contract
rng.gating: always-running default. active-only sensitivity is idealized and excludes wakeup/transition energy

quality.digital_bf16: Prior full WT2 Base PPL reference; not hardware validation
quality.digital_int8_ffn: Prior deterministic INT8 weight FFN numerical reference; mixed FP/INT MAC cost remains adjustable
quality.fixed_sc_exact: Exact SiLU*z recoding variant not yet independently quality-evaluated; no PPL attached
quality.dual_sc_sz: Full WT2 conditional Gaussian numerical PPL; hardware correlations and precision must be validated separately
